text: The $\textbf{Federal}$ $\textbf{Reserve}$ cut the $\textbf{Federal}$ $\textbf{Funds}$ $\textbf{Rate}$ to a $\textbf{45}$-$\textbf{year}$ $\textbf{low}$ of **1.0%** in June 2003.
